title: Empty peer / insight shells under a queue focal
cues: Blank insight cards under a green queue focal — e.g. Active in Usul or Missed awards with only a title + kicker and no list, table, metrics, or action
ban: Do not leave empty peer/insight Card shells beside a queue focal after dual-focal / KPI / CTA structure clears — they read as AI slop.
remediation: Emit collapse-empty-shells; remove title+kicker-only non-focal shells, or park deferred insight prose in <details data-shine-deferred-shell>; re-measure empty-insight-shells.
examples: SLED Capture queue: Active in Usul card with only a heading + diagnostic kicker after XOR fold
Missed awards & recompetes peer card with no rows, metrics, or next action under the Queue focal
